name: Unrivaled Yeast
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: the best hops
ingredients.originalText: two ounces of the best hops

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of brown sugar

instructions.text: On one morning boil two ounces of the best hops in four quarts of water half an hour
strain it, and let the liquor cool to the consistency of new milk
put it in an earthen bowl and add half a cupful of salt and half a cupful of brown sugar
beat up one quart of flour with some of the liquor
mix all well together, and let it stand till the third day after
add six medium-sized potatoes, boiled and mashed through a colander
let it stand a day, then strain and bottle and it is fit for use
It must be stirred frequently while it is making, and kept near a fire
if care be taken to let it ferment well in the bowl, it may immediately be corked tightly
keep it in a cool place
Before using it shake the bottle up well

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. On one morning boil two ounces of the best hops in four quarts of water half an hour
2. strain it, and let the liquor cool to the consistency of new milk
3. put it in an earthen bowl and add half a cupful of salt and half a cupful of brown sugar
4. beat up one quart of flour with some of the liquor
5. mix all well together, and let it stand till the third day after
6. add six medium-sized potatoes, boiled and mashed through a colander
7. let it stand a day, then strain and bottle and it is fit for use
8. It must be stirred frequently while it is making, and kept near a fire
9. if care be taken to let it ferment well in the bowl, it may immediately be corked tightly
10. keep it in a cool place
11. Before using it shake the bottle up well
